# Python API

The API reference is built from the docstrings of the `lunarops` package. Programs and configuration files are the supported entry points; the Python API is documented for extension work and for scripts that combine LunarOps components directly.

| Page | Contents |
|---|---|
| [Base utilities](base.md) | Physical constants, parameter names, station identities and serialization helpers. |
| [Configuration](config.md) | Loading, expanding and validating YAML runs; schemas; the class registry; the run context. |
| [Time](time.md) | Two-part Julian-date epochs with explicit UTC, TT and TDB scales, and time-scale conversion. |
| [Ephemerides](ephemerides.md) | Body states and lunar orientation evaluated from the Chebyshev records of SPICE kernels. |
| [Frames](frames.md) | Earth orientation, ITRF-GCRS transformation, relativistic BCRS/GCRS/LCRS transformations, coordinate scaling. |
| [Delays](delays.md) | Tropospheric and relativistic propagation delays. |
| [Displacement](displacement.md) | Station and reflector displacement models. |
| [Range bias](range-bias.md) | Deterministic range-bias tables. |
| [Observation](observation.md) | Normal points, catalogs, the light-time solution, the observation model, equation batches and prediction. |
| [Parametrization](parametrization.md) | Estimable parameter blocks and their design matrices. |
| [Dynamics](dynamics.md) | Lunar orbit and rotation propagation: bodies, forces, torques, deformation, integrators, accepted history. |
| [Estimation](estimation.md) | Least-squares core, stochastic model, Earth-orientation effects, constraints and the nonlinear adjustment. |
| [File I/O](fileio.md) | Native artifact readers and writers and external format importers. |
| [Programs and CLI](programs.md) | Program registry, program implementations, shared workflow helpers and the command-line interface. |
| [Parallel](parallel.md) | MPI task distribution and epoch prefetching. |
| [IERS routines](iers.md) | Validated Python interface to the compiled IERS Conventions routines. |
